title: mow money
pitch: mow the lawn, get paid, hire a goat, mow the moon, sell the business to a guy named doug.
how_to: drag, point or use wasd to steer the mower. cut grass pays cash; long straight passes build a streak.
spend it on upgrades: a wider blade, more speed, sprinklers, goats, robots and doug.
buy the next lawn for a bigger cash multiplier. mow into gnomes for a bonus.
sell the business for compost: permanent perks, and new lawns open up.
controls: drag or tap on the lawn to steer the mower (touch), or just point with the mouse (desktop), or wasd / arrow keys. tabs: upgrades, lawns, gnomes, sell. keys: u / l / g open tabs, esc closes, m = sound, p = pause. sound button top right (saved).
